title: Website Screenshot API output
description: One record per run: the screenshot, the change ratio versus the previous run, and the diff image when something changed.

results.title: Run result
results.description: Change ratio, baseline key and metadata of this run.

screenshot.title: Screenshot
screenshot.description: The captured image. The key is `screenshot.png`, or `screenshot.jpeg` when the input asks for jpeg; the exact key is also in every dataset row as `screenshotKey`.

diff.title: Diff image
diff.description: Changed pixels highlighted in red. Present only when the page differs from the baseline.
